The full Connect/gRPC interceptor chain is registered in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138`:
```go
connectInterceptors := connect.WithInterceptors(
    NewMetadataInterceptor(),   // header -> gRPC metadata
    NewLoggingInterceptor(logStacktraces),
    NewRecoveryInterceptor(logStacktraces),
    NewAuthInterceptor(authorizer),
)
```
These four interceptors (defined in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`) do metadata copying, logging, panic recovery, and authentication only — none of them count or limit request rates.

The Echo HTTP middleware stack (`/bench/repo/server/server.go:51-52`) is only:
```go
echoServer.Use(middleware.Recover())
echoServer.Use(newCORSMiddleware(profile))
```

  ```go
  thumbnailSemaphore:       semaphore.NewWeighted(3), // 3 concurrent thumbnail generations
  imageProcessingSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(2), // 2 concurrent EXIF-strip ops
  ```
  These are process-wide `golang.org/x/sync/semaphore` weighted limits (3 and 2), shared across ALL users — they cap concurrency, not request rate. Acquired in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_image.go:67-76`. When exhausted, `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:158-160` returns:
